name: Hide Title Bar Badges
author: tago
description: Choose which badges show next to the Ascendara name, like "Torrenting is enabled - use VPN".
details: Pick the badges to hide in this plugin's options. They come back when the plugin is turned off. Only the badges are hidden: torrenting, Big Picture and everything else keep working. Update and connection badges always stay visible.
affects: Hides the title bar badges you choose

settings.label: Hide "Torrenting is enabled - use VPN"
settings.description: Using a VPN is still recommended while torrenting.
